title: 第三章 此身亲朋
content_zh:
待仆人远去，贾珩这边在屋中，换了一身短打，取了一把宝剑，来庭院中，练起武艺来，前世在观中借读道藏，跟着祖父的一位忘年交，学习武艺，那人传了他拳脚功夫和兵器，其中就有一百零八路乾罡剑以及六合刀，后来从了军，又学了一些军中的格斗擒拿之术，等闲七八人，近不得身。
贾珩手提长剑，拉开架势，热了热身。
不得不说，这身子骨打熬的不错，也省了他不少功夫。
长剑出鞘，寒光飒然，剑鸣如水龙之吟，清越激荡，搅动的剑风，卷起庭院中树叶飞起。
身如轻燕，回身一刺，庭院中的婴儿手臂粗细的毛竹，被一剑刺中，剑没及柄，颤鸣不停。
「好剑法！」
就听到得鼓掌之声传来，声音浑厚丶粗犷。
贾珩面色顿了下，抬眸去看来人，见说话之人是国字脸，颌下蓄着胡须的青年，头戴黑色冠帽，脸上有着一道浅浅刀疤，笑道：「原来是蔡兄。」
来者二人，左边之人年岁十六左右，是贾珩表哥，名为董迁，在五城兵马司为小校，另外一位则是蔡权，是乳母蔡氏的内侄，现今为禁军京营的小军官。
陈汉国初效唐宋之制，及太宗时，又仿明制，于大汉神京设十二团营，以四王八公十二侯中的十二侯分掌兵权。
又在地方行省一级设都司，代兵部司掌卫所之军，这在国初是考虑到尽快平复朱明被灭后的乱局，部分承接了朱明一世的体制，为解决号令不一之事，又在军中杂糅唐制节度使之职。
故而造成地方守备与节度使并行，京营名义长官也为京营节度使。
蔡权笑道：「大郎，这身武艺纵然在军中，也能数一数二了。」
这时，蔡氏就道：「去去，一天天就知道胡说，大郎是要读书科举为官作宰的，去作丘八作甚？」
「姑母这话说的，丘八怎麽了？也一样是是天子皇粮，为朝廷效力嘛。」蔡权笑了笑，朗声说道。
蔡氏瞪了自家侄子一眼，道：「董姑娘走时，可说过的，要让哥儿读个进士出来，你再底下煽风点火的，我可不依你。」
这边厢，贾珩就引着蔡权和董迁进屋说话，有丫鬟桂香倒了茶，贾珩笑道：「两位兄长，今儿怎麽这麽得闲，过来看我？」
「这不是听你表兄说，你受了伤，就过来看看，身子可大好了吧，方才这麽一见，倒是大好了。」蔡权关切说道。
贾珩道：「劳蔡兄挂念，只是一些皮外伤，将养几天，也就无碍了。」
董迁笑道：「也不是哥哥说你，和那贾蓉每日厮混，还不若在军中谋个差事，也不辱没了兄弟一身武艺。」

蔡权也是附和道：「是啊，兄弟，这年景一天比一天难过，总要寻个营生才好，方今九边正是用人之时，以贤弟的胆识丶能为，将来混个差事，出人头地，再讨上一房媳妇，封妻荫子，岂不美哉？」
他之所以撺掇着贾珩从军，也有一点儿私心，贾家子弟从军在他手下为小校，怎麽的也要受贾家在军中残馀旧部的瞩目，哪怕资源漏得一星半点，也够他仕途之上受用不尽。
贾珩叹了一口气，说道：「去军中为一小卒，刀枪拼杀，重现先荣宁二公之荣光，也是珩平生所愿，然而……」
他读国史，知九边也是效前明而设，经太祖太宗两代皇帝奋武扬威，勉强将草原之胡患阻挡于九边镇外。
然后百年倏过，随着国朝承平日久，文恬武嬉，九边之外的草原部族渐渐恢复过来元气，此消彼长之下，关外之地逐渐失守，几十年前，辽东更是崛起了女真人，建立大金朝，每到秋高马肥，就会领兵犯边。
「不瞒蔡兄，弟意由科举入仕。」
国朝承平日久，文官集团膨胀，已有以文御武之相，尤其今上，虽自即位以来，雄心壮志，想要平定边患以及流寇之乱，内阁都换了两茬儿，但对文臣借重，仍不减分毫。
想那贾雨村同样是文人出身，最后得贾家之助，竟得授兵部大司马（尚书）之职，就是沾了两榜进士这块儿金字招牌的光。
蔡权惊讶道：「科举属实正途，不意贾兄真有如此之志？」
董迁也面色动容道：「表弟不是平日最厌烦读书的嘛？今日如何竟开了窍？」
刚才就觉得自家这表弟，是愈发变了样子，气质沉静了许多。
贾珩淡淡一笑，说道：「说来，还是前日被梁侍郎公子那一棍给敲醒了，大丈夫立身于世，还是得多读书才是，读书明理，否则在那等公子哥眼中，我等赳赳武夫，也不过是不值一看的小人物罢了。」
「贾兄，这话倒是不错，如那关云长，也是手拿春秋不离手，粗通大义，俺老蔡虽不喜那酸文假醋的穷酸秀才，但也爱听那说书讲古。」蔡权颔首笑着说，目中就有几分异色涌动。
心道，这贾家大郎，原以为只是有几分蛮力，不想还有这等见识？
众人正在说着话，贾珩道：「还要请教蔡大哥，哪里有良驹贩卖？」
读书科举也罢，武艺也是不能落下。
蔡权道：「马市上就有，不过皆是劣马，要寻宝驹，恐怕要费一番心思，怎麽兄弟要学骑射？」
董迁笑道：「表弟若是学骑射，我有位师父，算是骑射高手，倒是可以教你。」
贾珩点了点头，说道：「最近的确打算学，不知表兄，那位高手现在何处？若是拜师，需要准备多少束侑？」
董迁笑道：「那位高手，名唤谢再义，原是军中百户，因酒后误事，开罪了上司，现在只在城门做守门校尉，你若是想学，多准备些酒肉就是了。」

所谓城门校尉，其实就是普通军卒，这是被一撸到底。
贾珩点了点头，说道：「那事不宜迟，我们现在去看看，顺道也好买几本书。」
众人说着，贾珩就和蔡氏说了一声，随着董迁和蔡权向着外间去了。
大汉之神京，人烟阜胜，街道喧哗，贾珩先买了一些酒菜，然后穿过荣宁街，就向着城门而去。
神京都城，安化门，近午时分，贾珩终于在挨着安化门的一座破旧宅院中，见到了董迁口中的谢百户。
谢百户蹲坐在天井院中的石墩子上，拿着破布在擦着一把刀，范阳笠的头盔在一旁随意放着，斜眼打量了董迁一眼，然后将目光投在蔡权和贾珩身上，暗道，军中之人还有一个小娃娃，就是皱眉道：「这般兴师动众的，有事儿？」
董迁道：「谢哥，来看看你。」
「非年非节的，老子有什麽好看的？」谢再义冷哼一声，抬眼打量了一眼几人手中提着的礼盒以及酒菜，道：「礼下于人，必有所求，说吧，什麽事？」
董迁嘿嘿笑道：「确有一桩事儿，要烦劳谢哥。」
贾珩这时，接过话头，上前抱拳道：「听闻谢兄擅于骑射，在下贾珩，宁国公之后，想随着谢兄学习骑射之艺。」
谢百户冷笑了声，道：「宁国公的后人？倒是没看出来，你贾家寻什麽样的武师没有，怎麽偏偏寻老子消遣？」
说着，就打量了一眼贾珩，见其衣衫简素，已猜测出了七八分缘故。
恐怕已经是宁国府的远支。

content_en:
After the servant left, Jia Heng changed into a dagger in the house, took a sword, and went to the courtyard to practice martial arts. In his previous life, he studied Dao Zang in the temple and learned martial arts from his grandfather's old friend.
Jia Heng held the long sword in his hand, opened his stance, and warmed up.
I have to say that the body's bones were well tempered and it saved him a lot of effort.
The long sword was unsheathed, the cold light flashed, the sound of the sword was like the roar of a water dragon, the clear water stirred, and the stirring sword wind blew up the leaves in the courtyard.
Like a light swallow, he turned around and stabbed the bamboo as thick as a baby's arm in the courtyard. He was stabbed by a sword. The sword did not reach the hilt and kept trembling.
"Good swordsmanship!"
Then I heard the sound of applause, the sound was rich and rough.
Jia Heng's expression paused for a moment, and he raised his eyes to see who was coming. He saw that the person speaking was a young man with a Chinese character face, a beard under his chin, wearing a black crown, and a light scar on his face. He smiled and said, "It turns out to be Brother Cai."
There are two people coming. The one on the left is about sixteen years old. He is Jia Heng's cousin, named Dong Qian, who serves as a junior colonel in the Wucheng Military and Horse Division. The other one is Cai Quan, the nephew of the wet nurse Cai Shi, and is currently a junior officer in the Beijing Camp of the Forbidden Army.
The Chen Han Kingdom initially followed the system of the Tang and Song Dynasties, and at the time of Emperor Taizong, it imitated the Ming Dynasty system and set up twelve regiments and camps in the Shenjing of the Han Dynasty, with the military power divided among the twelve princes among the four princes, eight princes and twelve princes.
The capital department was also set up at the provincial level, and the acting military department was in charge of the garrison army. In the early days of the country, this was done to quell the chaos after Zhu Ming was destroyed as soon as possible. It partly inherited the system of Zhu Ming I. In order to solve the problem of inconsistent orders, the post of Jiedushi envoy under the Tang system was mixed in the army.
Therefore, the local garrison and the Jiedushi envoys work in parallel, and the nominal commander of the Beijing camp is also the Jiedushi envoy of the Beijing camp.
Cai Quan smiled and said, "Dalang, your martial arts skills are among the best in the army."
At this time, Mrs. Cai said: "Go, go, I know it's nonsense every day. Da Lang wants to study for the imperial examination and become an official and a butler. Why do you go to Qiu Ba?"
"As my aunt said, what happened to Qiu Ba? He is also the emperor's emperor and serves the court." Cai Quan smiled and said loudly.
Mrs. Cai glared at her nephew and said, "When Miss Dong left, she said that she wanted my brother to become a Jinshi. If you continue to fan the flames, I won't listen to you."
Over here, Jia Heng led Cai Quan and Dong Qian into the room to talk. A maid, Guixiang, poured tea. Jia Heng smiled and said, "Brothers, why are you so free today? Come and see me?"
"Didn't I just listen to your cousin and say that you were injured, so he came over to see you. You are feeling much better. I saw you just now, and you are much better." Cai Quan said with concern.
Jia Heng said: "Brother Lao Cai is worried about him. It's just some superficial injuries. He will be nursed for a few days and then it will be fine."
Dong Qian smiled and said, "It's not like my brother said that you and Jia Rong hang out every day. It would be better to find a job in the army and it would not be a disgrace to your brother's martial arts."
Cai Quan also echoed: "Yes, brother, the situation is getting more and more difficult every day. It is better to find a way to make a living. Now it is the time for Jiubian to employ people. With the courage and ability of my virtuous brother, wouldn't it be wonderful to work as an errand in the future, make a name for myself, find a wife, and be a wife?"
The reason why he encouraged Jia Heng to join the army was a little selfish. The children of the Jia family joined the army as junior high schools under him, so they had to attract the attention of the remaining members of the Jia family in the army. Even if the resources were leaked, it would be enough for him to use up his official career.
Jia Heng sighed and said, "It is Heng's lifelong wish to serve as a soldier in the army, fight with swords and guns, and regain the glory of his father Rong Ning. However..."
He read the history of the country and knew that Jiubian was also established in the Ming Dynasty. After two generations of emperors, Taizu and Taizong, worked hard to control the grassland's wild beasts outside Jiubian Town.
Then a hundred years passed quickly,As the country was at peace for a long time, Wen Tian and Wu were active, the grassland tribes outside the Nine Borders gradually recovered their vitality. Under the one-and-done situation, the lands outside the Pass were gradually lost. A few decades ago, the Jurchens emerged in Liaodong and established the Great Jin Dynasty. Every time the autumn was high and the horses were fat, they would lead troops to invade the borders.
"To be honest, Brother Cai, I want to take the imperial examination and become an official."
The country has been at peace for a long time, and the civil service group has expanded, and it has begun to use civil servants to control military affairs. Especially now, although since taking the throne, he has been ambitious and wants to quell border troubles and rogue bandits, and has changed the cabinet twice, but he still owes no less to the civil servants.
I think that Jia Yucun was also a scholar. Finally, with the help of the Jia family, he was awarded the post of Chief Sima (Shang Shu) of the Ministry of War. It was because of the golden sign of being a Jinshi with two rankings.
Cai Quan was surprised and said: "The imperial examination is the right way. I didn't expect Brother Jia to really have such ambitions?"
Dong Qian also looked moved and said, "Isn't my cousin the one who hates reading the most on weekdays? How did he become enlightened today?"
Just now I felt that my cousin had changed more and more, and his temperament was much calmer.
Jia Heng smiled faintly and said: "Speaking of which, I was woken up by the stick from Mr. Liang Shilang the day before yesterday. A real man should study more and be sensible in order to stand up in the world. Otherwise, in the eyes of such young men, I and Jiujiu Wufu will be nothing more than little people worth looking at."
"Brother Jia, that's a good thing. For example, Guan Yunchang has the Spring and Autumn Period in his hand and is knowledgeable about righteousness. Although I, Lao Cai, don't like the poor scholar who writes sour words and fake jealousy, I also like to listen to those storytellers who talk about ancient times." Cai Quan nodded and said with a smile, with a bit of strange color in his eyes.
I thought to myself, this Jia family man, I thought he only had some brute strength, but he didn’t expect to have such knowledge?
While everyone was talking, Jia Heng said, "I would also like to ask Brother Cai, where can I buy good horses?"
Regardless of studying for the imperial examination, martial arts must not fall behind.
Cai Quan said: "There are some in the horse market, but they are all bad horses. I'm afraid it will take a lot of effort to find a treasure horse. Why do brothers want to learn riding and shooting?"
Dong Qian smiled and said, "If my cousin wants to learn riding and archery, I have a master who is a master of riding and archery. He can teach you."
Jia Heng nodded and said: "I do plan to learn recently. I wonder, cousin, where is that master now? If I want to become a disciple, how many bundles of clothes do I need to prepare?"
Dong Qian smiled and said: "That master, whose name is Xie Zaiyi, was originally a member of the army. He offended his superiors because of drunkenness and misbehavior. Now he only works as a guard at the city gate. If you want to learn from him, just prepare more food and wine."
The so-called city gate captains were actually ordinary soldiers, and they were beaten to the end.
Jia Heng nodded and said, "It's not too late, let's go take a look now and buy some books along the way."
While everyone was talking, Jia Heng spoke to Cai and followed Dong Qian and Cai Quan to the outside.
The capital of the Han Dynasty was crowded with people and the streets were noisy. Jia Heng first bought some wine and food, then walked through Rongning Street and headed towards the city gate.
At nearly noon in Anhua Gate, the capital city of Kyoto, Jia Heng finally saw the Xie Baihu whom Dong Qian mentioned in a dilapidated house next to Anhua Gate.
Xie Baihu was squatting on the stone pillar in the courtyard, wiping a knife with a rag. Fan Yangli's helmet was lying casually aside. He glanced sideways at Dong Qian, then turned his attention to Cai Quan and Jia Heng, and secretly thought that there was a little kid in the army. He frowned and said, "Is there something wrong with such a large-scale mobilization of troops?"
Dong Qian said: "Brother Xie, come and see you."
"It's not the New Year, it's not a holiday, what's so good about me?" Xie Zaiyi snorted coldly, raised his eyes and looked at the gift boxes and wine and food in the hands of several people, and said: "When you give a courtesy to others, you must ask for something. Tell me, what's the matter?"
Dong Qian chuckled and said, "There is indeed something I need to trouble you about, brother."
At this time, Jia Heng took over the conversation, stepped forward and clasped his fists, saying, "I heard that Brother Xie is good at riding and shooting. After I serve Jia Heng and Ning Guogong, I want to learn the art of riding and shooting from Brother Xie.". "
Xie Baihu sneered and said: "Descendants of Ning Guogong? I didn't realize it. Your Jia family doesn't have any kind of martial artist, so why do you choose me for entertainment?"
After saying that, he took a look at Jia Heng and saw that he was wearing simple clothes. He had already guessed the reason.
I'm afraid it's already a distant branch of Ningguo Mansion.
